variables.toolTip: When the light turns on, animate the intensity of the light using the settings below. If this is disabled, the light will just go from off to on in one frame.

metaData.tooltip: When the light turns on, animate the intensity of the light using the settings below. If this is disabled, the light will just go from off to on in one frame.

variables.toolTip: When animating the light to power on, this determines the curve from 0 to full intensity. A value of 1 would be a linear animation.

metaData.tooltip: When animating the light to power on, this determines the curve from 0 to full intensity. A value of 1 would be a linear animation.

variables.toolTip: Add a dynamic material instance to this array, to have a scalar parameter called "Light Toggle" be set alongside the effect on the light component. Useful for controlling the emissive color on a light fixture's material. The Light Toggle parameter is a 0-1 value.

metaData.tooltip: Add a dynamic material instance to this array, to have a scalar parameter called "Light Toggle" be set alongside the effect on the light component. Useful for controlling the emissive color on a light fixture's material. The Light Toggle parameter is a 0-1 value.

variables.toolTip: If enabled, the light will be turned on at night, and turned off during the day. If disabled, the opposite.

metaData.tooltip: If enabled, the light will be turned on at night, and turned off during the day. If disabled, the opposite.

variables.toolTip: If more than 0, turning off and on will be randomly delayed, with this value as the max of the random range, in seconds. Good for adding variation to scenes with lots of lights that toggle, so they all don't come on at exactly the same moment.
